directory.label: App directory
directory.title: Choose an app
directory.description: Small, practical apps for focused tasks.
directory.emptyDescription: Try a different name, category, or keyword.

vocal.description: Guided vocal exercises and practical reference tools for everyday singing practice.

spotifyPlaylistPrinter.description: Fetch a Spotify playlist, then copy, download, or print its track list.

opmlGenerator.description: Create downloadable OPML files from feed URLs and organized subscription lists.

lineSorter.description: Sort and clean newline-separated text with precise ordering options.

tableViewer.description: Turn CSV, TSV, and pasted data into a searchable table.

pomodoro.description: Alternate focused work with short, intentional breaks.

colorToolkit.description: Convert colors, build tints and shades, and check readable contrast.

dateCalculator.description: Measure the calendar and total time between two dates.

unitConverter.description: Convert common length, mass, temperature, speed, and storage units.

pomodoro.title: Pomodoro Timer
pomodoro.description: A simple focus timer with short breaks, long breaks, and a clear session rhythm.
pomodoro.sound: Play a sound when time is up
pomodoro.note: The timer stays accurate while this tab is in the background. Keep the tab open during your session.

colorToolkit.title: Color Toolkit
colorToolkit.description: Explore a color, copy HEX, RGB, and HSL values, generate a tonal palette, and check text contrast.
colorToolkit.previewText: A quick preview of text on this color.
colorToolkit.invalid: Enter a valid 3- or 6-digit HEX color.
colorToolkit.copyHelp: Select any value to copy it.
colorToolkit.copyFailed: Could not copy the value. Select it and copy manually.
colorToolkit.paletteHelp: Select a swatch to copy its HEX value.
colorToolkit.contrastHelp: WCAG contrast against white and black text. AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text or 3:1 for large text.
colorToolkit.privacy: All color calculations happen in this browser. Nothing is uploaded or saved.

qrGenerator.title: QR Code Generator
qrGenerator.description: Create a customizable QR code from text or a link, then download it as PNG or SVG.
qrGenerator.contentHelp: Enter the exact text or link that should appear when the code is scanned.
qrGenerator.tooLong: This content is too long for the selected error-correction level. Shorten it or choose a lower level.
qrGenerator.empty: Enter text or a link to create a QR code.
qrGenerator.scanHelp: Test the downloaded code with a scanner before publishing or printing it, especially after changing colors.
qrGenerator.privacy: Your content is encoded in this browser. It is not uploaded or saved.

dateCalculator.title: Date Passed Calculator
dateCalculator.description: Find how much time has passed between two dates in calendar units and exact totals.

direction.future: The first date is after the second

dateCalculator.calendarHelp: Calendar units account for real month lengths and leap years.
dateCalculator.note: Dates are compared as calendar days. Times of day, daylight-saving changes, and time zones are not included.

unitConverter.title: Unit Converter
unitConverter.description: Convert common measurements instantly with clear units and a copyable result.
unitConverter.note: Results are rounded for display. Calculations retain full numeric precision in this browser.

opml.label: Feed utility
opml.title: OPML Generator
opml.description: Build an organized subscription list and download it as a standard OPML file.

importStates.importedDuplicates: OPML imported. {count} duplicate feeds were skipped.
importStates.invalid: This file is not valid OPML.
importStates.noFeeds: No feed subscriptions were found in this file.
importStates.tooLarge: Choose a file smaller than 2 MB.

opml.previewEmpty: Add a complete feed to generate the OPML preview.
opml.privacy: Generated and imported locally. Your draft stays in this browser and nothing is uploaded.

errors.feedUrlInvalid: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS feed URL.
errors.websiteUrlInvalid: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS website URL.
errors.fixEntries: Complete the required fields and fix invalid URLs.
errors.copyFailed: The browser could not copy the OPML. You can still download it.

lineSorter.label: Text utility
lineSorter.title: Line Sorter
lineSorter.description: Sort, clean, and export newline-separated text directly in your browser.
lineSorter.copyFailed: The browser could not copy the result.
lineSorter.privacy: Processed locally in your browser. Your text is not uploaded or saved.

error.default: This page could not be found.

practice.label: Practice
practice.videoNotice: Embedded from YouTube. If playback is blocked, open it on YouTube.
practice.defaultSafetyCue: Stop if you feel pain, throat pressure, dizziness, or scratchiness.
practice.defaultPrivacyCue: No microphone is used or recorded in this practice.
practice.videoPrivacyCue: No microphone is used. YouTube loads only when you open the guide.
practice.rangePrivacyCue: The practice player does not use the microphone. Range detection asks for microphone access only when you start it; video guides load only when opened.

tools.label: Practice tools
tools.title: Utilities for checking and timing practice.
tools.description: Use these tools outside the exercise flow. They do not force a sequence and can support any topic.

rangeDetector.label: Range tool
rangeDetector.title: Find vocal range
rangeDetector.noRange: Sing a comfortable low note and high note to estimate your range.
rangeDetector.noManualRange: Set your comfortable low and high note to estimate your range.
rangeDetector.rangeOrder: Set the lowest note below the highest note.
rangeDetector.lowTip: Move downward until the note is still comfortable and not pushed.
rangeDetector.highTip: Move upward until the note is still comfortable and not strained.
rangeDetector.manualCue: No microphone is used in manual mode. Work gently; save only notes that feel easy and repeatable.
rangeDetector.cue: Microphone access starts only after you press Start detection. Audio stays in this browser and is not recorded.
rangeDetector.permissionError: Microphone access was blocked or unavailable.

metronome.label: Timing tool
metronome.title: Metronome
metronome.standardCue: BPM controls click speed. Measure beats only changes the accent cycle.

piano.label: Reference tool
piano.title: Piano
piano.cue: Tap a key to hear a reference note. This uses generated audio only; no microphone is used.

playlistPrinter.title: Spotify Playlist Printer
playlistPrinter.description: Fetch a Spotify playlist, then copy, download, or print its track list.
playlistPrinter.help: Enter a Spotify access token and a playlist link or ID. Spotify may restrict access to playlists you own or collaborate on.
playlistPrinter.empty: Fetch a playlist to preview its tracks.
playlistPrinter.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the preview text and copy it manually.
playlistPrinter.privacy: Your token is sent only to Spotify and is not saved. Clear removes the token and results from this tab.
playlistPrinter.tokenHelp: Use an access token obtained through your Spotify developer app, not a client ID or client secret. Private playlists require playlist-read-private permission.

errors.invalidPlaylist: Enter a valid Spotify playlist URL, URI, or 22-character ID.
errors.unauthorized: Your token is invalid or expired. Paste a new access token and try again.
errors.forbidden: Spotify denied access. Check token permissions and developer-app access. You may need to own or collaborate on this playlist.
errors.notFound: Playlist not found or not accessible with this token. Check the link and playlist access.
errors.rateLimited: Spotify is limiting requests. Wait a little, then try again.
errors.requestFailed: Spotify could not return the complete playlist. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach Spotify. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: Spotify took too long to respond. Please try again.

eInk.title: E-Ink Feed
eInk.description: Build a personal news-link page for your e-reader. Choose sources, adjust the layout, and download one small HTML file.
eInk.sourceHelp: Start with a few sources or add any website. This page links to news sites; it does not fetch headlines or download articles.
eInk.noSources: Choose a source above or add your own link to get started.
eInk.invalidSource: Enter a name and a valid HTTP(S) website URL. The optional lightweight URL must also be valid.
eInk.previewHelp: Preview of the downloaded file. Links are inactive here; they work in the downloaded page.
eInk.fixErrors: Complete or correct the source fields to preview and download your page.
eInk.downloaded: Download started. Transfer news.html to your reader when ready.
eInk.transfer2: Connect your reader by USB and copy the file to a folder you can access on the device.
eInk.transfer3: Open the HTML file in a supported reader or browser. Connect to Wi-Fi to visit a news source.
eInk.compatibility: HTML support varies by device and firmware. If your reader cannot open local HTML, this file can also be hosted as a static web page and bookmarked in its browser. Articles are not included for offline reading.
eInk.privacy: Your page is saved in this browser only. No account or uploads. The downloaded page has no scripts, external fonts, or images.
eInk.exportFooter: Connect to the internet to open a news source. Created with Alyuid.

draft.idle: Draft saved locally when you edit.
draft.restored: Your saved page has been restored.
draft.unavailable: Browser storage is unavailable or the saved draft could not be read. You can still edit and download.

tableViewer.title: Table Viewer
tableViewer.description: Turn CSV, TSV, and pasted data into a searchable table.
tableViewer.fileHelp: CSV, TSV, or UTF-8 text · up to 5 MB
tableViewer.inputHelp: Paste comma-, tab-, or semicolon-separated text. Quoted values and multiline cells are supported.
tableViewer.pending: The input has changed. Click View table to update the displayed data.
tableViewer.uncertain: No consistent separator was detected. Comma is being used; select a separator manually if needed.
tableViewer.uneven: Rows have different lengths. All values are retained; missing cells appear empty.
tableViewer.noRows: This input contains headers but no data rows.
tableViewer.sortHelp: Click a header to sort: ascending, descending, then original order.
tableViewer.emptyHelp: Open a file, paste some data, or try the example to see a table.
tableViewer.privacy: Files and text are processed in this browser only. Nothing is uploaded or saved. Limits: 10,000 data rows, 200 columns, and 200,000 cells including headers.

errors.tooLarge: The input exceeds 5 MB. Choose a smaller file or paste less text.
errors.encoding: Use a UTF-8 CSV, TSV, or text file. This input contains an unsupported encoding or binary data.
errors.empty: Enter some data or choose a non-empty file.
errors.malformed: Invalid CSV quoting near record {row}. Check closing quotes and the selected separator.
errors.tooManyRows: This table exceeds 10,000 data rows. Split it into smaller files.
errors.tooManyCells: This table exceeds 200 columns or 200,000 cells. Split it into smaller files.
errors.readFailed: The file could not be read. Please choose it again.
